# GET /api/v1/admin/hooks

List system and/or default webhooks with pagination

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (admin required) · **ID:** `ep-091`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |

| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |
| type | query | string | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

- **500** — Database error or decryption failure
